title: Willowmere Tanneryside REIT 招标决定
instruction:
您是 Jelena Coutinho，Willowmere Solutions 的个人财务顾问，负责准备客户案例回复，法律部门的 Edith Lombardi 将在 Clara Bruns 接到电话之前批准该回复。 Clara 是 68，并在 Tanneryside 贸易公司赞助的非交易房地产投资计划中拥有 41,000 单位。她几年前通过不再可用的经纪人获得了整个头寸，她记录的总成本基础是$502,250，并且该头寸不是在退休账户中持有。赞助商的投标窗口于下午5:00 关闭。 30 九月 2026，因此 Edith 需要一份可供决策的记录，而不是另一个持有摘要。克拉拉 (Clara) 表示，她希望获得最佳价值，但她还需要在 15 10 月 2026 之前至少清算 $280,000 的收益作为护理社区押金，并且不希望出售过多的单位。莫德·达尔加德 (Maude Dalgaard) 已确认存款日期已确定。法里达·加拉格尔 (Farida Gallagher) 早些时候分发了一份内部说明，将赞助商声称的资产净值描述为克拉拉 (Clara) 单位今天的价值；伊迪丝不会批准未纠正印象的客户回复。
病例记录中不应添加任何附件和外部研究；仅使用本消息中的事实，识别任何与决策相关的未知因素，而不是用假设来填充它，并且不要说明确切的税收结果、未来分配或未来单位价值。 Tanneryside 目前显示的每单位资产净值为$10.42，或 Clara 头寸的$427,220。基础评估日期为3112月2023，资产净值发布于283月2024，随后并未刷新。保荐人于1411月2024暂停了其普通赎回计划，并且尚未宣布恢复，因此在Clara的存款截止日期之前持有这些单位不会提供预定的流动性。赞助商当前的投标为每单位$7.60，允许投标任何数量的单位，对已接受的收益收取2%处理费，如果总投标超过5,000,000单位计划限制，则可以按比例分配，并预计于1511月2026结算。不保证接受和接受的单位数量。克拉拉可以在截止日期前撤回投标，但赞助商尚未提出加速结算的建议。
该记录还包含四个过期的主动小型投标：每单位$6.35最多25,000单位到期31一月2025，$6.70最多60,000单位到期31三月2025，$7.15最多35,000 单位将于 30 6 月 2025 到期，以及 $7.40 最多 50,000 单位将于 31 8 月 2025 到期。没有一个仍然可以行使，也没有一个提供克拉拉本人完成销售的证据。 2024第四季度报告的该计划的实际二级平台交易量为$6.20的4,000单位和$6.35的2,500单位； 2025第一季度5,000$6.55和3,000$6.70； 2025第二季2,000$6.85、7,500$7.00、4,000$7.10；以及2025第三季度的$7.20的1,500和$7.05的6,000。这些是已完成的交易而不是上市，二级平台向卖家收取总收益1%。 Clara 当前可执行的二级出价为所有41,000 单位的每单位$7.05，无融资条件，1% 卖方费用，于20 9 月2026 结算，并于5:00 下午到期。 12九月2026。买方不会购买部分头寸。当前没有其他二次投标记录。
因此，克拉拉要求不出售多余单位，这与唯一记录在案的二级交易相冲突，该交易可以在截止日期前清算足够的现金，而较高的赞助商投标提供更多名义收益，但无法在该日期之前提供清算资金，并且可能不接受每个单位。 Willowmere 政策允许您在投标、持有或接受记录的二次投标之间提出有限制的建议，但您不得建议依赖于无记录的买方的结果，假设有条件投标将被完全接受，或提出当前可用的过期投标。为伊迪丝准备一份简明的客户案例回复，建立一个合理的估值范围，比较不同时期的证据，解释重大变化以及资产净值与可实现证据之间的差异，显示相关替代方案的经济性，记录解决克拉拉的竞争要求，并准确提出一项建议。该建议必须以单一的预期净收益数字为基础，该数字在任何地方都一致，并且响应必须以决策本身而不是后续步骤列表为基础。将其控制在不超过四页，使其适合法律审查和后续客户对话，并仅使用该文件名将 `clara_bruns_reit_decision.pdf` 写入工作目录的顶层。
---

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：

- `clara_bruns_reit_decision.pdf` — 一份客户案例回复，介绍估值范围、期间比较、替代经济学以及一项供法律审查的招标或出售决定。 （仅使用请求中的非公开记录事实；不超过四页；仅包含一项具有一致净收益锚点的建议；完成决策；不要发明数字或陈述确切的税务结果。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

WILLOWMERE SOLUTIONS / CONFIDENTIAL CLIENT CASE RESPONSE



 DECISION RECORD | 30 AUGUST 2026


              Clara Bruns — Tanneryside Trading Company liquidity decision
 Prepared by Jelena Coutinho, Personal Financial Advisor, for Edith Lombardi / Legal. Closed-record analysis for a firm care-community deposit of $280,000 in cleared funds by 15
 October 2026.

  Position                                     Recorded basis                       Hard requirement                                 Decision set

  41,000 units of the non-traded Tanneryside   $502,250 aggregate recorded          Deposit date is firm; Maude Dalgaard             Bounded policy choice: sponsor
  Trading Company real estate investment       cost basis ($12.25/unit); not held   confirmed it. Clara seeks best available         tender, hold, or documented
  program                                      in a retirement account              value and prefers not to sell more units than    secondary bid. No undocumented
                                                                                    necessary.                                       buyer or partial buyer may be
                                                                                                                                     assumed.


 Decision lens: value evidence is not the same as available cash
 Tanneryside displays NAV of $10.42/unit ($427,220). That figure is appraisal-based: underlying appraisal dated 31 December 2023, posted 28 March 2024, with no subsequent refresh. It must
 not be presented as Clara’s current cash-equivalent value, guaranteed sale price, or directly realizable market value. It is a sponsor-reported estimate, not a current observable public-market price.

  Present evidence                               Gross per unit / position            What it means for valuation

  Documented executable secondary bid            $7.05 / $289,050                     Lower realizability anchor: buyer will take all 41,000 units on stated terms.

  Sponsor tender — conditional                   $7.60 / $311,600                     Upper realizability anchor only if accepted; timing and accepted quantity are
                                                                                      uncertain.

  Decision-oriented present gross range          $7.05–$7.60 /                        Not an average of NAV and market evidence. The $7.60 endpoint is conditional
                                                 $289,050–$311,600                    and untimely for Clara’s need.

 Why the NAV gap is not resolved by “splitting the difference.” The $7.05 bid is 32.34% below NAV (discount measured against NAV). The gap can reflect the old appraisal date and appraisal
 method, non-traded illiquidity, small and irregular historical trade sizes, seller fees, and the conditions attached to actual execution. Completed trades and executable offers are realizability
 evidence; neither they nor NAV are a perfectly observable public-market price.




                                                                                                                                                                                Clara Bruns | Legal review | 1
 WILLOWMERE SOLUTIONS / CONFIDENTIAL CLIENT CASE RESPONSE



 EVIDENCE THROUGH TIME


                                                                      Historical market record
 Historical observations inform context only. They do not create an available offer or establish what a 41,000-unit position will clear at today.

 Completed secondary-platform transactions — actual clearing events, not listings, bids, or NAV
  Period                Completed transactions                                                                   Like-for-like range / reading

  Q4 2024               4,000 units @ $6.20; 2,500 @ $6.35                                                       $6.20–$6.35

  Q1 2025               5,000 @ $6.55; 3,000 @ $6.70                                                             $6.55–$6.70

  Q2 2025               2,000 @ $6.85; 7,500 @ $7.00; 4,000 @ $7.10                                              $6.85–$7.10

  Q3 2025               1,500 @ $7.20; 6,000 @ $7.05                                                             $7.05–$7.20

 Like-for-like completed-trade evidence moved upward from $6.20–$6.35 in Q4 2024 to $7.05–$7.20 in Q3 2025. The direction is favorable, but the sample is small and irregular, and prices are
 dispersed. The historical prints range from 1,500 to 7,500 units; they do not guarantee continued appreciation, a current $7.20 price, or execution for all 41,000 units.

 Expired unsolicited mini-tenders — historical bidder appetite only; none is exercisable and none evidences a sale by Clara
  Expired offer price              Maximum units             Expiry                          Treatment

  $6.35/unit                       25,000                    31 January 2025                 Expired historical indication

  $6.70/unit                       60,000                    31 March 2025                   Expired historical indication

  $7.15/unit                       35,000                    30 June 2025                    Expired historical indication

  $7.40/unit                       50,000                    31 August 2025                  Expired historical indication

 These unsolicited offers suggest changing bidder appetite over time, but they are not completed transactions, do not prove Clara sold any units, and cannot be treated as currently available prices.

 Liquidity context
 The ordinary redemption plan was suspended on 14 November 2024 and no resumption has been announced. Holding is not a statement that the units are worthless or permanently unsaleable; it
 means there is no scheduled liquidity before 15 October 2026 on this record.




                                                                                                                                                                              Clara Bruns | Legal review | 2
 WILLOWMERE SOLUTIONS / CONFIDENTIAL CLIENT CASE RESPONSE



 ALTERNATIVES


                                                                Economics and timing test
 Amounts are shown consistently as gross proceeds less stated seller/processing fee = net proceeds. “Expected” does not eliminate stated execution conditions.

  Alternative                  Economics for 41,000 units                 Expiry / settlement                Execution and deadline result

  Accept current secondary     Gross $289,050                             Expires 5:00 p.m. 12 Sep 2026      All 41,000 only; no financing condition. Settlement
  bid                          1% seller fee: $2,890.50                   Settles 20 Sep 2026                precedes 15 Oct deadline; expected net exceeds
                               Expected net: $286,159.50                                                     $280,000 by $6,159.50.

  Sponsor tender               Full-acceptance scenario only:             Tender closes 5:00 p.m. 30 Sep     Any number may be tendered, but 5,000,000-unit
                               Gross $311,600                             2026                               program limit may cause proration. Acceptance and
                               2% fee: $6,232                             Expected settlement 15 Nov 2026    accepted count are not guaranteed. Expected
                               Net $305,368                                                                  settlement follows deadline.

  Hold                         No stated sale proceeds or fee             No scheduled liquidity before 15   Ordinary redemption remains suspended; no
                                                                          Oct 2026                           announced resumption. Does not fund the firm
                                                                                                             deposit on the record.


 The tender’s potential full-acceptance premium is $22,550 gross ($311,600 versus $289,050) or $19,208.50 net ($305,368 versus $286,159.50). It is nominally higher but cannot satisfy the firm
 liquidity deadline: expected settlement is after 15 October and proration can reduce accepted units. The withdrawal right through the deadline does not create liquidity, and no accelerated settlement
 has been offered.

 Requirement collision
 Clara’s wish not to sell excess units is reasonable. So is the need for cleared proceeds by the firm date. They conflict because the only documented bid that clears in time is all-or-none for 41,000
 units; the buyer will not purchase a partial position. The documented sale produces $6,159.50 more cash than required, but it is the bounded trade-off that secures the deadline without inventing
 another buyer.
 The current bid is the only documented current secondary bid: $7.05/unit for all 41,000 units, no financing condition, 1% seller fee, expiry at 5:00 p.m. on 12 September 2026, and settlement on
 20 September 2026.




                                                                                                                                                                                Clara Bruns | Legal review | 3
 WILLOWMERE SOLUTIONS / CONFIDENTIAL CLIENT CASE RESPONSE



 LIMITS AND DISPOSITION


                                                 What the record supports — and does not
 This is a bounded liquidity decision, not a formal appraisal, tax opinion, or forecast.

 Material limits
  Known from the record                                                                   Not determined by the record

  The secondary bid is executable on its stated all-unit terms and has no financing       Client-specific tax consequences; future unit value; future distributions; sponsor
  condition. The tender is conditional, subject to a 5,000,000-unit limit, and expected   redemption resumption; tender acceptance or proration; and any future secondary
  to settle after the funding date. Historical trades were completed but smaller than     price or buyer. No value is assigned to these unknowns.
  Clara’s position.

 Basis and tax context
 Against the recorded aggregate cost basis of $502,250, the documented sale’s expected net proceeds of $286,159.50 are an economic/cash difference of $216,090.50. That comparison is not an
 exact deductible loss, tax result, or tax benefit. Tax treatment depends on client-specific information not in this closed record.

 Decision rationale
 The stated NAV remains useful as a dated appraisal-based reference, but it does not cure the funding constraint or override realizable evidence. Holding has no scheduled liquidity before the
 deposit date. The tender’s higher full-acceptance net scenario is conditional and expected after the deadline. The documented secondary bid is the only listed alternative that has an identified buyer,
 a stated settlement before the deadline, and expected net proceeds sufficient for the deposit.


                            DECISION


                            Decline the sponsor tender and accept the documented all-or-none secondary bid for all 41,000 units at
                            $7.05 per unit, producing expected net proceeds of $286,159.50 and cleared funds on 20 September
                            2026—before the firm 15 October 2026 deposit deadline.




                                                                                                                                                                                Clara Bruns | Legal review | 4

criteria.description: 所需的可交付成果以可读、未损坏的 PDF 形式存在，名称准确为 clara_bruns_reit_decision.pdf。
criteria.evidence: 提交的文件和 PDF 元数据
criteria.grader_hint: 确认确切的文件名、PDF 类型、成功打开以及可提取或可见呈现的内容。

original.criterion: The required deliverable exists as a readable, non-corrupt PDF named exactly clara_bruns_reit_decision.pdf.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the exact filename, PDF type, successful opening, and extractable or visibly rendered content.

criteria.description: 完整的响应不超过四个渲染页面。
criteria.grader_hint: 计算所有 PDF 页数，包括封面或附录页（如果有）。

original.criterion: The complete response is no more than four rendered pages.
original.grader_hint: Count all PDF pages, including cover or appendix pages if present.

criteria.description: 该响应正确识别了 Clara Bruns、她的 41,000 单位职位以及 Tanneryside Trading Company。
criteria.grader_hint: 所有三个标识符都必须出现，并且不得在响应中的其他位置发生冲突。

original.criterion: The response correctly identifies Clara Bruns, her 41,000-unit position, and Tanneryside Trading Company.
original.grader_hint: All three identifiers must appear and must not conflict elsewhere in the response.

criteria.description: 该文件被视为可供法律审查的可供决策的客户案例回复，而不仅仅是一般的投资摘要。
criteria.evidence: 开场白、决策框架和结论
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的客户目标、替代方案、管理约束、分析和处置。

original.criterion: The document is framed as a decision-ready client case response for legal review, not merely as a generic investment summary.
original.grader_hint: Look for a clear client objective, alternatives, governing constraints, analysis, and disposition.

criteria.description: 记录的总成本基础表示为$502,250，容差为±$1。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果在 ±$1 范围内正确调节到 $502,250，则接受每单位 $12.25。

original.criterion: The recorded aggregate cost basis is stated as $502,250 with a tolerance of ±$1.
original.grader_hint: Accept $12.25 per unit if it is also correctly reconciled to $502,250 within ±$1.

criteria.description: 赞助商规定的资产净值以每单位$10.42和总计$427,220报告，分别在每单位±$0.01和总计±$1之内。
criteria.grader_hint: 每个单元的图形及其正确扩展的位置值都必须出现。

original.criterion: The sponsor-stated NAV is reported as $10.42 per unit and $427,220 in aggregate, each within ±$0.01 per unit and ±$1 in aggregate.
original.grader_hint: Both the per-unit figure and its correctly extended position value must appear.

criteria.description: 该响应将 $10.42 NAV 与 31 12 月 2023 评估日期、28 3 月 2024 发布日期以及稍后刷新的情况相关联。
criteria.evidence: 资产净值的来源和限制
criteria.grader_hint: 所有三个时间事实必须与资产净值相关联，而不是呈现为不相关的日期。

original.criterion: The response associates the $10.42 NAV with the 31 December 2023 appraisal date, the 28 March 2024 posting date, and the absence of a later refresh.
original.grader_hint: All three timing facts must be linked to the NAV rather than presented as unrelated dates.

criteria.description: 该回应积极劝阻将陈旧的赞助商资产净值视为当前现金等价物、有保证的销售价格或直接可实现的市场价值。
criteria.evidence: NAV 口译和面向客户的语言
criteria.grader_hint: 信用要求以清晰的语言进行肯定性修正，而不仅仅是将资产净值标记为估计值。

original.criterion: The response actively discourages treating the stale sponsor NAV as a current cash-equivalent, guaranteed sale price, or directly realizable market value.
original.grader_hint: Credit requires an affirmative correction in clear language, not merely labeling NAV as an estimate.

criteria.description: 该解释将基于评估的资产净值与实际交易和可执行报价生成的证据区分开来，但没有声称两者都是完全可观察的公开市场价格。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找适合非流动性非交易投资的平衡区别。

original.criterion: The explanation distinguishes appraisal-based NAV from evidence generated by actual transactions and executable offers without claiming that either is a perfectly observable public-market price.
original.grader_hint: Look for a balanced distinction appropriate to an illiquid non-traded investment.

criteria.description: 估值范围具有从记录的可实现替代方案中提取的可识别的下限和上限锚点，并且它不会使用辅助证据对 $10.42 NAV 进行机械平均。
criteria.evidence: 规定的估值范围和支持性解释
criteria.grader_hint: 一个强有力的答案是使用$7.05可执行的二次投标和$7.60有条件的赞助投标作为当前的总可实现性界限，同时明确限定上限。仅当每个端点都已记录且其限制明确时，才接受另一个严格推理的范围。

original.criterion: The valuation range has identifiable lower and upper anchors drawn from documented realizable alternatives, and it does not mechanically average the $10.42 NAV with secondary evidence.
original.evidence: Stated valuation range and supporting explanation
original.grader_hint: A strong answer uses the $7.05 executable secondary bid and $7.60 conditional sponsor tender as the present gross realizability bounds, while clearly qualifying the upper bound. Accept another tightly reasoned range only if every endpoint is documented and its limitations are explicit.

criteria.description: 如果使用可执行投标和赞助商投标来表示当前总可实现性范围，则其每单位端点为±$0.01内的$7.05和$7.60。
criteria.grader_hint: 当答复呈现首选现有证据范围时应用此项目；端点不得颠倒或未标记。

original.criterion: If the present gross realizability range is expressed using the executable bid and sponsor tender, its per-unit endpoints are $7.05 and $7.60 within ±$0.01.
original.grader_hint: Apply this item when the response presents the preferred present-evidence range; endpoints must not be reversed or unlabeled.

criteria.grader_hint: 验证每个金额等于规定的单位数字乘以 41,000 单位。

original.criterion: The gross position-value equivalents of $7.05 and $7.60 are shown as $289,050 and $311,600, respectively, each within ±$1.
original.grader_hint: Verify each amount equals the stated per-unit figure multiplied by 41,000 units.

criteria.description: 该答复确定了四项过期的小型招标及其各自的价格、容量限制和到期日期，并明确将所有四项招标归类为过期而非当前可执行。

original.criterion: The response identifies the four expired mini-tenders with their respective prices, capacity limits, and expiry dates and clearly classifies all four as expired rather than currently executable.

criteria.description: 过期的小型招标被用作投标人兴趣变化的历史指标，而不是作为克拉拉出售单位或仍然可以获得这些价格的证据。
criteria.grader_hint: 该文件必须保留主动要约和已完成交易之间的区别。

original.criterion: Expired mini-tenders are used as historical indications of changing bidder appetite, not as proof that Clara sold units or can still obtain those prices.
original.grader_hint: The document must preserve the distinction between an unsolicited offer and a completed transaction.

criteria.description: 响应涵盖所有九笔已完成的二级交易，并具有正确的季度、单位数量和清算价格。

original.criterion: The response covers all nine completed secondary transactions with the correct quarter, unit quantity, and clearing price.

criteria.description: 该回应明确区分了已完成的二级交易与上市、投标和保荐人报告的资产净值。
criteria.grader_hint: 读者应该能够辨别哪些观察记录了实际的清理事件。

original.criterion: The response clearly distinguishes completed secondary transactions from listings, bids, and sponsor-reported NAV.
original.grader_hint: A reader should be able to tell which observations document an actual clearing event.

criteria.description: 期间比较解释了从2024后期到2025的材料向上运动，同时承认分散性和小且不规则的交易样本。
criteria.grader_hint: 信贷既需要方向性结论，又需要限制对稀疏的非流动性市场观察的过度解释。

original.criterion: The period comparison explains the material upward movement from late 2024 through 2025 while acknowledging dispersion and the small, irregular transaction samples.
original.grader_hint: Credit requires both the directional conclusion and a limitation on overinterpreting sparse illiquid-market observations.

criteria.description: 该文件使用类似的二次清算证据来比较至少两个不同的时期，而不是将评估、过期报价和已完成的交易视为可互换的观察结果。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认比较基础明确且一致。

original.criterion: The document compares at least two distinct periods using like-for-like secondary clearing evidence rather than treating an appraisal, an expired offer, and a completed trade as interchangeable observations.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that the comparison basis is explicit and consistent.

criteria.description: 回复称，普通赎回计划已于11月1411月2024暂停，尚未宣布恢复。
criteria.grader_hint: 暂停日期和不恢复状态都必须存在。

original.criterion: The response states that the ordinary redemption plan was suspended on 14 November 2024 and has not been announced as resumed.
original.grader_hint: Both the suspension date and no-resumption status must be present.

criteria.description: 持有替代方案被评估为在 15 10 月 2026 之前不提供预定的流动性，且不会断言这些单位永久无法出售或毫无价值。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找有时限的流动性结论和适当限制的措辞。

original.criterion: The hold alternative is assessed as providing no scheduled liquidity before 15 October 2026 without asserting that the units are permanently unsaleable or worthless.
original.grader_hint: Look for a time-bounded liquidity conclusion and appropriately restrained wording.

criteria.description: 赞助商招标准确地描述为每单位$7.60，开放至30九月2026，需支付2%费用，预计于15十一月2026结算。

authoring_plan.solver_instance: A personal financial advisor must turn a closed factual record concerning an illiquid non-traded real estate investment into a legally reviewable client decision response.
authoring_plan.intended_verdict: Recommend that Clara Bruns not tender and instead accept the documented all-or-none secondary bid for all 41,000 units at $7.05 per unit, because its expected $286,159.50 net proceeds settle before the firm 15 October 2026 funding deadline. Explicitly resolve the fact that this produces $6,159.50 more cash than Clara needs and sells more units than her minimum-cash preference would otherwise require.
planted_tensions: The sponsor tender offers a higher nominal price and higher hypothetical net proceeds, but expected settlement occurs after the client’s firm cleared-funds deadline and acceptance can be prorated.
The client reasonably wants no more units sold than necessary, but the only documented secondary buyer that can satisfy the deadline will purchase only the complete 41,000-unit position.
Sponsor NAV is prominently stated and much higher than transaction evidence, but it rests on an old appraisal and is not a realizable cash price.
authoring_plan.common_misuse_to_correct: Do not describe the $10.42 sponsor NAV or $427,220 extension as what the client can currently realize. The gold should actively explain why appraisal-based NAV differs from executable and completed-market evidence.

gold_relationships.economic_basis_difference: $502,250 − $286,159.50 = $216,090.50; this is not an exact tax deduction.
gold_relationships.timing_test: 20 September 2026 secondary settlement precedes 15 October 2026; 15 November 2026 expected tender settlement follows it; holding has no scheduled liquidity before it.
gold_relationships.preferred_realizability_range: $7.05 to $7.60 per unit gross, or $289,050 to $311,600 gross for the position, with the upper endpoint expressly labeled conditional and untimely for the client’s need. The corresponding documented net outcomes are $286,159.50 and $305,368 under full tender acceptance.
gold_relationships.period_change: Completed secondary clearing prices generally rose from $6.20–$6.35 in Q4 2024 to $7.05–$7.20 in Q3 2025, but observations are sparse, transaction sizes vary, and none establishes a guaranteed current full-position price.

coverage_requirements: Carry every expired mini-tender price, capacity, and expiry accurately and classify each as historical rather than executable.
Carry all nine completed secondary transactions accurately by quarter, quantity, and clearing price.
Distinguish sponsor NAV, unsolicited mini-tenders, completed secondary trades, the current executable secondary bid, and the current conditional sponsor tender.
State the redemption suspension date and no announced resumption.
Compare tender, hold, and secondary sale on proceeds, fees, execution certainty, and timing.
Identify material unknowns without assigning values, especially client-specific tax treatment and future sponsor or market outcomes.
must_not_assert: The sponsor NAV is current market value, cash-equivalent value, or a guaranteed sale price.
The sponsor tender will accept all 41,000 units or settle before the stated expected date.
An expired mini-tender remains available or proves that Clara completed a transaction.
A small historical secondary trade guarantees execution for the full position.
The economic difference from basis is an exact deductible tax loss or produces a known tax benefit.
Historical price improvement guarantees continued appreciation.
An undocumented buyer, partial purchase, accelerated tender settlement, future distribution, or redemption-plan resumption exists.
authoring_plan.space_feasibility: The required work fits within four pages at normal professional presentation density: one concise decision summary, a compact evidence and period comparison, an alternatives table or equivalent, a short risk and limitation discussion, and a closing recommendation. The response need not reproduce raw records in prose if compact presentation preserves every graded fact.
authoring_plan.offline_validation: All required facts are contained in the request. Every arithmetic relationship can be recalculated with a calculator or Python, and the PDF can be authored and rendered using standard office libraries without internet access.

deliverables.description: A client case response presenting the valuation range, period comparison, alternative economics, and one tender-or-sale decision for legal review.
constraints: Use only the closed-record facts in the request; no more than four pages; include exactly one recommendation with a consistent net-proceeds anchor; finish on the decision; do not invent figures or state an exact tax result.

original_instruction:
You’re Jelena Coutinho, the personal financial advisor at Willowmere Solutions responsible for preparing the client case response that Edith Lombardi in legal will approve before Clara Bruns is called. Clara is 68 and owns 41,000 units in a non-traded real estate investment program sponsored by Tanneryside Trading Company. She acquired the entire position years ago through a broker who is no longer available, her recorded aggregate cost basis is $502,250, and the position is not held in a retirement account. The sponsor’s tender window closes at 5:00 p.m. on 30 September 2026, so Edith needs a decision-ready record rather than another holding summary. Clara has said that she wants the best value available, but she also needs at least $280,000 of cleared proceeds by 15 October 2026 for a care-community deposit and does not want more units sold than are necessary. Maude Dalgaard has confirmed that the deposit date is firm. Farida Gallagher circulated an earlier internal note describing the sponsor’s stated net asset value as what Clara’s units are worth today; Edith will not approve a client response that leaves that impression uncorrected. There are no attachments and no outside research should be added to the case record; use only the facts in this message, identify any decision-relevant unknown rather than filling it with an assumption, and do not state an exact tax result, future distribution, or future unit value. Tanneryside currently displays a stated NAV of $10.42 per unit, or $427,220 for Clara’s position. The underlying appraisal date is 31 December 2023, the NAV was posted on 28 March 2024, and it has not subsequently been refreshed. The sponsor suspended its ordinary redemption plan on 14 November 2024 and has not announced a resumption, so holding the units provides no scheduled liquidity before Clara’s deposit deadline. The sponsor’s present tender is $7.60 per unit, permits tenders of any number of units, charges a 2% processing fee against accepted proceeds, may be prorated if aggregate tenders exceed the 5,000,000-unit program limit, and is expected to settle on 15 November 2026. Acceptance and the accepted unit count are not guaranteed. Clara can withdraw her tender until the deadline, but the sponsor has not offered accelerated settlement. The record also contains four expired unsolicited mini-tenders: $6.35 per unit for up to 25,000 units expiring 31 January 2025, $6.70 for up to 60,000 units expiring 31 March 2025, $7.15 for up to 35,000 units expiring 30 June 2025, and $7.40 for up to 50,000 units expiring 31 August 2025. None remains exercisable, and none supplies evidence that Clara herself completed a sale. Actual secondary-platform transactions reported for this program were 4,000 units at $6.20 and 2,500 at $6.35 in the fourth quarter of 2024; 5,000 at $6.55 and 3,000 at $6.70 in the first quarter of 2025; 2,000 at $6.85, 7,500 at $7.00, and 4,000 at $7.10 in the second quarter of 2025; and 1,500 at $7.20 and 6,000 at $7.05 in the third quarter of 2025. These are completed trades rather than listings, and the secondary platform charges sellers 1% of gross proceeds. The current executable secondary bid available to Clara is $7.05 per unit for all 41,000 units, with no financing condition, a 1% seller fee, settlement on 20 September 2026, and expiry at 5:00 p.m. on 12 September 2026. The buyer will not purchase a partial position. No other current secondary bid is documented. Clara’s request not to sell excess units therefore conflicts with the only documented secondary transaction that can clear enough cash by her deadline, while the higher sponsor tender offers more nominal proceeds but cannot provide cleared funds by that date and may not accept every unit. Willowmere policy allows you to make a bounded recommendation among tendering, holding, or accepting the documented secondary bid, but you may not recommend an outcome that depends on an undocumented buyer, assume that a conditional tender will be accepted in full, or present an expired bid as currently available. Prepare a concise client case response for Edith that establishes a defensible valuation range, compares the evidence across periods, explains the material changes and the difference between NAV and realizable evidence, shows the economics of the relevant alternatives, resolves Clara’s competing requirements on the record, and makes exactly one recommendation. The recommendation must be anchored to a single expected net-proceeds figure that agrees everywhere it appears, and the response must finish on the decision itself rather than on a list of next steps. Keep it to no more than four pages, make it suitable for legal review and a subsequent client conversation, and write only `clara_bruns_reit_decision.pdf` into the top level of the working directory using exactly that filename.
